tagline.zh: 一个 Key，配置你的 AI 编程工具。
tagline.en: One key. Your AI coding tools, configured.

description.zh: 把模型识别、路由配置和用量查询放进一个桌面客户端，减少在不同工具的配置文件之间来回切换。
description.en: Discover models, configure routing, and track usage in one desktop app instead of juggling configuration files.

audience.zh: 同时使用多个 AI 编程工具，希望集中配置模型与查看用量的开发者。
audience.en: Developers who use multiple AI coding tools and want a central place for model configuration and usage.

projects.name: Rent Project · 支付宝租赁系统

tagline.zh: 让商品、租赁订单、合同与履约，在一套系统里协同。
tagline.en: Bring rental products, orders, contracts, and fulfillment together.

description.zh: 围绕租赁业务组织商品、订单、分期账单、电子合同与经营分析，用统一中台管理权限和配置。
description.en: Organize products, orders, installment bills, electronic contracts, and business analytics with shared access and configuration management.

audience.zh: 需要租赁运营后台、支付宝租赁接入和电子签约工作流的团队与开发者。
audience.en: Teams and developers building rental operations with Alipay workflows and electronic contracts.

tagline.zh: 品牌有没有出现在 AI 回答里？用证据看清，再动手优化。
tagline.en: Is your brand showing up in AI answers? Find the evidence, then improve.

description.zh: 把品牌提及、回答来源、官网审计、内容整改与复测报告放在同一套工作台里，让每次优化都能回到具体问题和原始证据。
description.en: Bring brand mentions, answer sources, website audits, content improvements, and retest reports into one evidence-led workspace.

audience.zh: 品牌运营、内容团队与 GEO 服务机构。
audience.en: Brand teams, content teams, and GEO service providers.

tagline.zh: 从一个想法，到可预览的 HTML、演示文稿和视频。
tagline.en: From an idea to HTML, presentations, and video.

description.zh: 在本地项目中描述需求，让 AI 生成或修改 HTML，边预览边调整，再导出 PPTX、MP4 或图片。
description.en: Describe what you need in a local project, create or refine HTML with AI, preview the result, and export to PPTX, MP4, or images.

audience.zh: 需要制作演示、动画与可视化内容的创作者和开发者。
audience.en: Creators and developers building presentations, animations, and visual content.

tagline.zh: 把行情、公告与研究记录，放到同一个工作台。
tagline.en: Your quotes, filings, and research notes—in one workspace.

description.zh: 不只看一张涨跌表：在中英文工作台里查看持仓、核对行情、跟踪异动和公告，并保留判断与复盘记录。
description.en: Go beyond a price table: review holdings, cross-check quotes, follow alerts and filings, and keep a record of your reasoning.

audience.zh: 希望结合可复核数据与 AI 整理 A 股、港股和美股研究的用户。
audience.en: Researchers who want verifiable data and AI-assisted workflows for mainland China, Hong Kong, and US equities.

tagline.zh: 把故事拆成分镜，把生成片段接成视频。
tagline.en: Turn stories into scenes, and generated clips into video.

description.zh: 从故事和长文本生成分镜计划，确认后运行有界并行任务，下载片段、拼接视频，并保留供后续剪辑使用的 manifest。
description.en: Plan scenes from a story, approve the prompts, run bounded parallel tasks, download and assemble clips, and keep a manifest for further editing.

audience.zh: 希望在 MCP 工作流中组织火山方舟视频生成任务的创作者与开发者。
audience.en: Creators and developers orchestrating Volcengine Ark video generation through MCP.

tagline.zh: 让散落在项目里的 Markdown，成为好找、好读、好交付的文档。
tagline.en: Make project Markdown easy to find, read, and deliver.

description.zh: 打开本地目录，搜索与阅读文档，进行轻量编辑，再导出 Word 或 PDF。文件留在磁盘上，工作围绕你的项目展开。
description.en: Open a local folder, search and read your docs, make light edits, and export to Word or PDF. Your files stay on disk.

audience.zh: 经常阅读 README、技术方案、产品文档与会议笔记的开发者和团队。
audience.en: Developers and teams working with READMEs, technical plans, product docs, and meeting notes.

projects.name: WeChat Writing Workflow · 公众号写作工作流

tagline.zh: 从素材到公众号草稿，把写作流程接起来。
tagline.en: Connect the steps from source material to a WeChat draft.

description.zh: 让 Codex 帮你整理初稿，在 WeMD 中审稿与调整排版，确认后再通过微信官方接口创建草稿，减少来回复制与转换。
description.en: Draft with Codex, review and format in WeMD, then create a draft through the official WeChat API after confirmation.

audience.zh: 用 Codex 辅助写作、希望保留人工审稿与排版环节的公众号作者。
audience.en: WeChat authors using Codex who want to keep human review and layout checks in the workflow.
